name: knowledgebot/core-api
description: KnowledgeBot AI control plane — identity, tenancy, bots, credentials, quotas, and every public API.

kb-notes.guzzle: Required EXPLICITLY, not pulled in transitively: opentelemetry-auto-guzzle hooks GuzzleHttp\Client::transfer(), and that hook is the only thing that carries traceparent across the Laravel->FastAPI seam. Without it every internal call is an unparented root trace, with no error anywhere.
kb-notes.paratest: ^7.23.1 — corrected from the earlier ^9.0 placeholder, which assumed paratest's major tracked PHPUnit's. It does not: paratest has no 8.x or 9.x, and 7.23.1 is the release that requires php ~8.4.0 || ~8.5.0 and phpunit/phpunit ^13.2.5. Pest v5.0.3 requires exactly `brianium/paratest ^7.23.1`, so this pin is Pest's own floor restated — `composer test:par` and Pest must never resolve to different paratest majors.
kb-notes.larastan: ^3.10 — corrected from ^4.0, which does not exist on Packagist. Larastan's major tracks PHPStan's, not Laravel's: 3.x is the PHPStan 2.x line, and v3.10.0 already accepts `illuminate/* ^13`. Bump only when Larastan 4 ships against PHPStan 3, and change phpstan.neon's rule level in the same commit.
kb-notes.collision: ^8.9.5 — corrected from ^9.0, which does not exist. Collision 8.x is Laravel 13-compatible by declaration: v8.9.5 conflicts with `laravel/framework <11.48.0 || >=14.0.0`, so 13.x is inside its supported window. Pest v5.0.3 requires `nunomaduro/collision ^8.9.5`; this pin matches it so the test runner and artisan's exception renderer stay on one copy.
kb-notes.platform: config.platform pins php 8.4.1 and ext-opentelemetry 1.2.1 so the open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-* packages resolve on a developer machine or CI image where the PECL extension is not installed. The runtime image must actually carry the extension: `php -m | grep opentelemetry` in CI. The php pin is the LOWEST supported runtime, not the newest available, and it must stay equal to the `require.php` floor — resolve against a higher version than production runs and the lock can contain packages production cannot install.
kb-notes.upload-extensions: ext-fileinfo and ext-zip are DECLARED because the upload intake gate depends on both and fails CLOSED without them. fileinfo IS libmagic: `UploadIntake::sniff()` throws rather than falling back to the extension, because an extension-derived MIME is the client's claim wearing the server's voice and is the exact check docs/03 8.10 requires. zip is what enumerates OPC part names for the vbaProject.bin / /embeddings/ refusal and reads the central directory for the three decompression caps. Both are enabled in php:8.4-fpm-bookworm (fileinfo by default, zip installed explicitly in the Dockerfile) and both are asserted at BUILD time in the same loop as pdo_pgsql, so a base-image change that dropped either fails the build rather than every upload.
kb-notes.php-floor: 8.4.1, not 8.4.0: pestphp/pest v5.0.3 requires symfony/process ^8.1.0, and symfony/process v8.1.0 requires php >=8.4.1. The floor is therefore set by a dev dependency, but `require.php` still carries it — a composer.json that advertises 8.4.0 while the lock needs 8.4.1 fails at install time on a platform check instead of at resolution. laravel/framework v13.24.0 itself only needs php ^8.3; the runtime image (php:8.4-fpm-bookworm) is comfortably above the floor.
kb-notes.deliberately-absent: laravel/fortify + laravel/passkeys (no login UI yet — add with the auth surface), laravel/sail (Compose lives in infrastructure/docker and is platform-devops's), spatie/laravel-permission (roles are hand-rolled per laravel-rbac-policies: its team scoping is ambient static state), phpunit/phpunit as a direct dependency (Pest owns that constraint; a direct pin is how the two drift).
kb-notes.http-client-adapter: open-telemetry/exporter-otlp needs a PSR-18 client + PSR-17 factories. Guzzle 7 provides PSR-7/17 but discovery may still ask for php-http/guzzle7-adapter. If `composer install` reports an unsatisfied psr/http-client-implementation, add php-http/guzzle7-adapter — it is the expected resolution, not a surprise. OUTCOME at first lock generation: not needed. open-telemetry/sdk 1.15.0's `psr/http-client-implementation ^1.0` and `psr/http-factory-implementation ^1.0` are satisfied virtually by guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.15.3 and guzzlehttp/psr7 2.13.0, which is the second reason guzzle is required explicitly. php-http/discovery 1.20.0 is in the lock as a transitive of the exporter and is allow-listed as a plugin; it is the RUNTIME discovery that could still fail if guzzle were ever dropped.
